tagline: STIHL equipment and service for Kaitaia's outdoor work
heroSubheading: We supply and service STIHL equipment for farms, gardens, and land management.
aboutHtml:
We're Johno and Carol, and we run STIHL SHOP Kaitaia to keep Northland equipped with quality outdoor power equipment. Whether you're managing farmland, maintaining a section, or clearing scrub and fallen timber, we stock the STIHL machines built to handle the work. They're built tough for the conditions we have here.

We don't just sell equipment. We service what we supply, stock genuine STIHL parts, and give straight advice on what you actually need. When something breaks or needs maintenance, bring it in and we'll get it running again. We know what works in this region.

Come in and talk to us about the right STIHL for your job. We're open Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, and Saturday from 8.30am to 3pm.
servicesIntro: We service and repair STIHL equipment, stock genuine parts, and offer maintenance advice for locals.
